这是一款面向SLM（选区激光熔融）3D打印的自研全流程切片软件，旨在配合公司自主: An in-house slicing application for SLM (selective laser melting) 3D printing, developed to control and optimize complex manufacturing processes on the company's own printers. It covers the full workflow: model import, orientation optimization, automatic nesting, support generation, and final slice output.
渲染引擎的作用是把三维模型和切片结果以可视化的方式展示出来，让用户能直观地看到打: The rendering engine visualizes 3D models and slicing results, giving users a clear view of the printed shape, support structures, and each individual layer.
基于OpenGL的高性能3D渲染引擎，实现模型的实时预览和交互操作。支持多种着色: A high-performance OpenGL rendering engine provides real-time model previews and interactive controls. Multiple shading modes, lighting effects, and camera controls make the printing workflow easy to inspect.
自动支撑负责为模型中那些悬空或容易变形的部分自动添加支撑结构。它的作用是帮助模型: Automatic support generation adds structures beneath overhangs and areas prone to deformation, keeping the model stable during printing and helping prevent collapse or distortion.
智能自动支撑生成系统，通过临界角判定、种子面片合并、轮廓偏移采样与射线求交算法，: The support generator combines critical-angle detection, seed-face merging, offset-contour sampling, and ray intersections to create pillar and grid supports. Manual editing and 19 adjustable parameters, including critical angle, support density, and pillar diameter, help improve print reliability.
自动摆放能帮助用户将多个模型在打印平台上自动排列到合适的位置。它会根据模型的大小: Automatic nesting positions multiple models on the build platform. It adjusts their orientation and spacing based on size and shape to avoid overlaps and make efficient use of the available space.
基于动态NFP（No-Fit Polygon）结合遗传算法的智能摆放系统，实现高: A nesting system combines dynamic no-fit polygons (NFPs) with a genetic algorithm to arrange multiple models compactly. Rotation and mirroring improve build-platform utilization, reduce printing costs, and save preparation time.
切片是软件的核心部分，它将三维模型“切”成一层层的平面，并根据这些层生成打印机可: Slicing converts a 3D model into a series of planar layers, then generates paths and instructions the printer can execute. This turns a complex virtual shape into a layer-by-layer manufacturing plan for a physical object.
集成稳健的多边形布尔运算（Clipper2/CGAL）与高精度层片轮廓提取。支持: Robust polygon Boolean operations using Clipper2 and CGAL are combined with precise layer-contour extraction. Configurable layer thickness, infill density, and boundary handling produce high-quality paths compatible with the printer. Blue lines indicate the laser paths.
姿态优化：让牙冠开口向上的同时兼顾打印效率: Orientation optimization: keep dental crown openings facing upward while maintaining printing efficiency
智能摆放：在有限的空间摆下更多的不规则的模型: Automatic nesting: fit more irregular models into a limited build area
自动支撑：根据支撑参数快速找到待支撑区域并生成对应的支撑: Automatic supports: quickly identify regions requiring support and generate structures from the chosen parameters
切片核心：确保切片的结果在实际的打印中符合工艺要求: Slicing core: ensure that the resulting slices meet manufacturing requirements in actual prints
GPU加速计算：采用冠状体开口识别算法结合GPU编程进行加速，自动寻找最优打印方: GPU acceleration: combine crown-opening detection with GPU programming to automatically find a suitable printing orientation
bin-packing算法：基于动态NFP（No-Fit Polygon）结合遗: Bin packing: combine dynamic no-fit polygons with a genetic algorithm to arrange multiple models compactly
几何算法优化：集成稳健的多边形布尔运算（Clipper2/CGAL）: Geometric optimization: integrate robust polygon Boolean operations with Clipper2 and CGAL
工艺兼容性：反复试验，不断打印不同参数的切片结果: Process compatibility: repeatedly print and evaluate slicing results using different parameters
完整的切片软件系统，支持SLM 3D打印全流程: A complete slicing application covering the full SLM 3D printing workflow
显著提升了打印准备效率和成功率: Substantially improved print-preparation efficiency and print success rates
实现了复杂模型的自动化处理: Automated the processing of complex models
一款专业的数字化正畸矫治器设计软件，专为口腔正畸技师和临床医生开发，旨在通过先进: Professional digital orthodontic appliance design software for dental technicians and clinicians. Advanced 3D rendering and precise geometric calculations support the complete archwire design process. Integration with the company's wire-bending machine exports standardized manufacturing data, connecting digital design with physical production.
高性能3D渲染引擎用于展示口腔模型和矫治器设计。通过精确的可视化，医生和技师能够: A high-performance 3D engine displays dental models and appliance designs. Accurate visualization helps clinicians and technicians inspect tooth alignment, occlusion, and the proposed appliance to support clinical decisions.
基于OpenGL的专业3D渲染引擎，支持口腔模型的高质量渲染和实时交互。提供多种: An OpenGL rendering engine provides high-quality dental model visualization and real-time interaction. Front, side, and occlusal views, along with material and lighting controls, reveal fine design details. The engine was adapted from the slicing application.
关键点编辑功能允许医生在牙齿模型上标记和调整关键位置点。这些关键点定义了弓丝的走: Keypoint editing lets clinicians mark and adjust important positions on a dental model. These points define the archwire path and the direction of orthodontic forces, supporting precise appliance design.
基于BVH快速求交的关键点编辑系统，支持在3D模型上精确标定牙齿的托槽位置、咬合: A keypoint editing system uses fast BVH intersection queries to accurately locate bracket positions, occlusal contact points, and other features on 3D models. It supports automatic detection and manual fine-tuning.
模型挖补功能用于修复扫描模型中的缺陷和不完整区域。通过算法自动填充缺失部分或移除: Model sculpting and repair address defects and incomplete regions in scanned models. Algorithms fill missing areas or remove unwanted geometry to provide a complete, accurate foundation for subsequent design.
基于CGAL库研发的挖补功能，除了能够手动雕刻模型，还能实现倒凹的自动填补: CGAL-based sculpting and repair tools support manual model editing and automatic undercut filling.
碰撞检测系统实时检查弓丝设计与口腔组织之间的干涉。确保矫治器不会与牙龈、舌头或对: Collision detection checks for interference between the archwire design and oral anatomy in real time. It helps avoid unwanted contact with the gingiva, tongue, or opposing teeth, supporting comfort and safety.
使用胶囊碰撞检测算法，实时计算弓丝与口腔组织的距离和接触情况。提供可视化反馈和自: Capsule collision detection computes distances and contacts between archwires and oral anatomy in real time. Visual feedback and automatic optimization suggestions help designers identify and resolve potential interference and assess clinical feasibility.
3D渲染技术：实现口腔模型和矫治器的精确可视化: 3D rendering: accurately visualize dental models and orthodontic appliances
关键点标定：关键点要精确的同时还要距离模型有一定距离: Keypoint placement: position points precisely while maintaining the required clearance from the model
模型修复：自动修复扫描数据中的缺陷和不完整区域: Model repair: automatically address defects and incomplete areas in scanned data
碰撞检测：实时计算弓丝与口腔组织的干涉情况: Collision detection: calculate interference between archwires and oral anatomy in real time
OpenGL渲染引擎：采用OpenGL实现高质量3D可视化和实时交互: OpenGL rendering: provide high-quality 3D visualization and real-time interaction
关键点标定：采用BVH快速求交算法同时在面片的法相了方向做偏移: Keypoint placement: use fast BVH intersection queries and offset points along triangle normals
几何修复算法：使用CGAL库集成先进的网格修复和填充算法: Geometric repair: integrate advanced mesh repair and filling algorithms with CGAL
空间计算优化：把胶囊碰撞检测放入computershader中进行计算: Spatial computation: run capsule collision detection in compute shaders

基于VR外向内追踪技术的机械臂轨迹规划系统，采用前后端分离架构。手持HTC Vi: A robotic arm trajectory planning system based on outside-in VR tracking, with separate frontend and backend applications. Moving a handheld HTC Vive Tracker records a trajectory in real time; the path can be visualized and edited in MuJoCo before a robotic arm reproduces it. Applications include robotic polishing, electronics assembly, and physiotherapy robotics.
VR设备定位精度：HTC Vive Tracker的原始数据存在抖动和漂移，影响: VR tracking accuracy: jitter and drift in raw HTC Vive Tracker data affect trajectory recording
高频数据传输：VR追踪器产生高频位置数据（30Hz），需要低延迟的传输方案: High-frequency data transfer: tracking data generated at 30 Hz requires a low-latency communication channel
系统架构设计：VR设备、Web前端、Python后端、机械臂控制器之间需要高效的: System architecture: synchronize data efficiently across the VR tracker, web frontend, Python backend, and robot controller
实时物理仿真：需要在MuJoCo中实时渲染机械臂运动并进行碰撞检测: Real-time physics simulation: visualize robotic arm motion and detect collisions in MuJoCo
多厂商机械臂适配：需要支持不同品牌机械臂的控制协议和运动学模型: Multi-vendor robot support: accommodate different control protocols and kinematic models
使用卡尔曼滤波算法对VR设备的位置数据进行平滑处理，消除抖动和漂移，提高轨迹精度: Apply Kalman filtering to smooth VR position data, reduce jitter and drift, and improve trajectory accuracy
采用WebSocket + RESTful API混合通信架构：WebSocke: Use a hybrid WebSocket and REST API architecture: WebSocket streams high-frequency tracking data, while REST handles basic CRUD operations
前端使用TypeScript构建Web界面，后端使用Python处理数据和控制逻: Build the web interface in TypeScript and process data and control logic in Python, with independent frontend and backend applications
集成MuJoCo物理引擎进行机械臂运动仿真和轨迹可视化，支持实时预览和碰撞检测: Integrate MuJoCo for robotic arm simulation and trajectory visualization, including real-time previews and collision detection
集成ESP32处理力传感器数据，通过蓝牙传输握持力度信号，控制轨迹记录的启停: Use an ESP32 to process force-sensor data and transmit grip-force signals over Bluetooth to start and stop trajectory recording
完整的前后端分离VR轨迹规划系统: A complete VR trajectory planning system with separate frontend and backend applications
成功测试三种不同厂商机械臂的轨迹复现: Successfully tested trajectory reproduction on robotic arms from three manufacturers
应用于工业打磨、组装和医疗理疗场景: Applied to industrial polishing, assembly, and physiotherapy scenarios

一个用于管理多台SLM（选择性激光熔化）金属3D打印机的工业级制造执行系统。采用: An industrial manufacturing execution system for managing multiple SLM metal 3D printers. Separate frontend and backend applications provide live equipment monitoring, production scheduling, data analysis, and material inventory management. Real-time updates, concurrent device management, and Docker deployment support the digital operation of metal additive manufacturing workshops.
多设备实时监控：需要同时监控多台打印机的关键参数（氧含量、仓压力、风机频率、过滤: Live equipment monitoring: display oxygen concentration, chamber pressure, fan frequency, and filter differential pressure for multiple printers simultaneously
高频数据处理：设备传感器产生高频数据流，需要高效的数据采集、处理和存储方案: High-frequency data processing: efficiently collect, process, and store continuous sensor data

前后端通信：实时数据推送、RESTful API调用、数据库事务处理需要统一的通: Frontend-backend communication: unify real-time updates, REST API calls, and database transactions
生产数据分析：需要实现OEE（设备综合效率）计算、产量统计、材料消耗分析等复杂业: Production analysis: implement OEE calculations, output statistics, and material consumption analysis

完整的工业级MES系统，支持多设备管理: A complete industrial MES with support for multiple devices

全国大学生智能车竞赛是中国自动化学会主办的国家级赛事，以实车比赛的形式考验参赛队: The National University Student Smart Car Competition, organized by the Chinese Association of Automation, tests hardware design, software algorithms, and system integration through races with physical vehicles. Our team competed in two consecutive years, earning a national first prize (20/565) and a national second prize. The project combines OpenCV lane detection, YOLO object detection, and PID motion control.

智能车采用上下位机分离架构，Edge Board作为上位机负责视觉感知，STM3: The smart car separates high-level perception from low-level motion control. An Edge Board handles vision, an STM32 controls movement, and the two exchange data over a serial connection.
